items.name: todo
items.title: Todo tools
items.description: Durable todo_read/todo_write for a trusted owner and thread. Host table agevexTodos; at most 100 unique items, 100-character ids, 4000-character text and 32 KiB UTF-8 per list. Core receipts deduplicate tool calls. Includes a bounded cleanup mutation.
items.docs: Use a TypeScript host with tsx: true in components.json before installing. Merge todoTables from the installed schema snippet into convex/schema.ts. Pass internal.agevexTools.todoState to createTodoTools and register on an agevex Agent with host authorize/authorizeExecution. Requires the host's existing agevex package. No schema is overwritten. See /docs/tools/todo.

items.name: goals
items.title: Goal tools
items.description: goal_set/goal_check for a trusted owner, thread and run. Host table agevexGoals: one row per owner and thread holding one explicit goal up to 4000 characters, owned by the run that set it. Core receipts deduplicate tool calls. Includes a bounded cleanup mutation.
items.docs: Use a TypeScript host with tsx: true in components.json before installing. Merge goalTables from the installed schema snippet into convex/schema.ts. Pass internal.agevexTools.goalsState to createGoalTools and register on an agevex Agent with host authorize/authorizeExecution. Requires the host's existing agevex package. No schema is overwritten. See /docs/tools/goals.

items.name: ask-user
items.title: Ask the user
items.description: ask_user is a deferred tool (no execute): the model asks one nonblank question up to 2000 characters and the turn waits. The owner answers with core answer({ threadId, toolCallId, text }); the model sees the text. No item tables; native pending-call state and core hold it.
items.docs: Use a TypeScript host with tsx: true in components.json before installing. Register createAskUserTool() on an agevex Agent with host authorize/authorizeExecution. Requires the host's existing agevex package. Answer with core answer, never by saving a native tool result directly. See /docs/tools/ask-user.

items.name: continue-budget
items.title: Continue budget
items.description: continue_budget requests native Agent approval with a nonblank reason up to 2000 characters. Host table agevexBudgetConsents records the owner's explicit consent (subject, thread, approval id) when your approve action calls core respond. resumeAfterBudgetStop, used inside one host mutation, checks that consent, raises your budget, cancels the run core stopped with BUDGET_EXCEEDED and sends a fresh request atomically. Includes a bounded cleanup mutation.
items.docs: Use a TypeScript host with tsx: true in components.json before installing. Merge consentTables from the installed schema snippet into convex/schema.ts. Register createContinueBudgetTool() on an agevex Agent with host authorize/authorizeExecution. Your approve action must call core respond and internal.agevexTools.continueBudgetState.record in one mutation; call resumeAfterBudgetStop inside ONE host mutation with your own budget policy write. Requires the host's existing agevex package. No schema is overwritten. See /docs/tools/continue-budget.
